case_number: Civil Appeal Nos. 2892-2894 of 2023 (Arising out of SLP (Civil) Nos. 8163-8165 of 2022)

parties.petitioner: M/S Suneja Towers Private Limited & Anr.

summary: Real estate possession delay; compound interest (14%) on refund; maintainability as consumer despite 60% payment; reliance on Manjeet Kaur Monga precedent; commercial booking not disqualifying; deficiency of service established; appeals allowed on limited interest issue.
legal_provisions_cited: Monopolies and Restrictive Trade Practices Act, 1969
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; compound interest direction set aside; refund without compounding upheld; stay conditions modified per interim order of 09.05.2022.
